en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3706 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said regarding the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Exalted:
"There is no good in much of their secret talk except in one who enjoins charity, or kindness, or reconciliation between people" (Surah An-Nisa 4:114)
Imam (as) said: "Kindness refers to giving a loan."
